lines.rom: jaya teri ho skanda mata pamcavam nama tumhara ata sabake mana ki janana hari jaga janani sabaki mahatari
teri jota jalata rahum maim haradama tujhe dhyata rahum maim kai namom se tujhe pukara mujhe eka hai tera sahara
kahim paharom para hai dera kai saharom mem tera basera hara mandira mem tere najare guna gaye tere bhakta pyare
bhakti apani mujhe dila do sakti meri bigari bana do indra adi devata mila sare kare pukara tumhare dvare
dusta daitya jaba carha kara aye tu hi khanda hatha uthaye dasom ko sada bacane ayi bhakta ki asa pujane ayi
